https://atid.store.core_purpose: The site provides an online platform for users to browse, select, and purchase fashion and lifestyle products, enabling a streamlined e-commerce shopping experience.
business_requirements: Users must be able to browse product categories and view detailed product information, including images, descriptions, and pricing.
Users must be able to add selected items to a shopping cart and proceed to checkout with a streamlined process.
Users must be able to create an account or log in to save purchase history, shipping details, and payment preferences for future transactions.
Users must be able to apply discount codes or promotional offers during checkout to adjust the total purchase price.
The system must provide secure payment options, including credit cards and digital wallets, and ensure encryption of sensitive information.
Users must be able to track order statuses and view shipping updates after completing a purchase.
The site must offer a responsive design that is accessible and functional across desktop and mobile devices.
